'''Jalina''' was a [[Tarasin]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Jalina was a member of the [[Hiironi irstat]], a Tarasin tribe that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jalina was present at a briefing in the jungles of Cularin, where [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Xirossk]] of the [[Cularin Militia]] sent the [[heroes of Cularin]] on a mission to find the [[Wyrd]].
